idea: A WhatsApp bot that reminds dental clinic patients about appointments and collects deposits

strategist.problem: A solo dental clinic in Jaipur loses ₹500-2000 per empty chair slot when a patient no-shows or cancels late, felt the moment the front desk sees an unfilled appointment at 10am on a weekday.
strategist.target_customer: Solo or 2-3 dentist dental clinics in Jaipur with 1-3 chairs, ₹3-10 lakh monthly revenue, whose front desk manually calls patients and still faces 15-25% no-shows.
strategist.mission: Give solo Indian dental clinics an automated WhatsApp reminder and deposit-collection bot so empty chair slots become paid appointments.

competitors.name: Practo / Lybrate appointment booking
competitors.differentiator: They own patient discovery, not the clinic's own reminder and deposit flow; we run inside the clinic's existing WhatsApp number.

competitors.name: Manual SMS/IVR reminder tools (e.g., MSG91-based scripts)
competitors.differentiator: SMS gets ignored and can't collect a UPI deposit; WhatsApp with a deposit link closes the loop in one thread.

competitors.name: Receptionist phone-call reminders
competitors.differentiator: Costs ₹8,000-15,000/month in staff time and stops after clinic hours; our bot runs 24x7 for a fraction of that.

scope_cuts: No patient-facing marketplace or clinic discovery app — we only serve the clinic's existing patient list via WhatsApp.
No custom EHR/PMS integration in v1 — we start with CSV/Google Sheets import of appointments to ship in 2-4 weeks.
No multi-language voice calls or IVR — WhatsApp text templates in Hindi/English only for MVP.

stack.name: Next.js
stack.why: App Router dashboard for clinics to upload appointment CSVs and see reminder/deposit status.

stack.name: Supabase
stack.why: Stores clinics, appointments, patients, reminder logs and deposit status in Postgres with auth.

stack.name: WhatsApp Business Cloud API
stack.why: Delivers reminders and deposit links on the channel Indian patients already reply to.

stack.name: Razorpay
stack.why: Payment links for patient deposits and the clinic's own ₹ subscription via UPI.

stack.name: Cloudflare Pages
stack.why: Free commercial-use hosting for the Next.js dashboard, unlike Vercel Hobby.

stack.name: n8n
stack.why: Self-hosted Community workflow engine that schedules reminders and parses inbound WhatsApp replies.

ai_tools.name: Claude
ai_tools.why: Claude Code writes the Next.js dashboard, Supabase schema and n8n webhook flows end to end.

ai_tools.name: Gemini API
ai_tools.why: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite classifies patient replies (confirm/cancel/reschedule) cheaply inside the bot.

mvp_features: CSV/Google Sheets appointment import plus automated WhatsApp reminder 24h and 2h before slot with a Razorpay UPI deposit link, marking the slot confirmed once payment or a YES reply lands.
Clinic dashboard showing today's appointments, reminder delivery status, deposit collected vs pending, and no-show flags from the last 30 days.
Hindi/English WhatsApp reply handling (confirm, cancel, reschedule) that writes back to the appointment row via Gemini classification.

first_10_steps: Register a .in domain (₹75/mo) on Cloudflare Registrar and point DNS at Cloudflare Pages.
Run `npx create-next-app@latest dental-remind --ts --tailwind --app` and push to a GitHub repo.
Create a Supabase project and run SQL for tables: clinics, appointments, patients, reminders, deposits.
Sign up for Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API, verify the test number, and send one template message to your own phone.
Build the CSV upload page in Next.js that inserts appointments into Supabase (target: 50 rows in 10 seconds).
Install n8n Community locally (`docker run -it --rm -p 5678:5678 n8nio/n8n`) and create a cron workflow firing 24h and 2h before each appointment.
Wire the n8n workflow to WhatsApp Cloud API send-message and to Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite for parsing patient replies.
Create a Razorpay payment link template for ₹500 deposits and paste the link into the reminder message payload.
Deploy to Cloudflare Pages (`npx wrangler pages deploy`) and run an end-to-end test: import 10 fake appointments, receive 10 WhatsApp reminders, collect 1 test UPI deposit.
Walk into 3 solo dental clinics in Jaipur with the live demo on your phone and book 1 paid pilot for next month.

pricing.name: Starter
features: 1 clinic, 1 WhatsApp number, up to 200 appointments/month, 24h+2h reminders, ₹500 Razorpay deposit links, CSV import, Hindi/English replies

pricing.name: Growth
features: Up to 3 dentists, 600 appointments/month, no-show analytics, Google Sheets sync, WhatsApp support

pricing.name: Extra messages
features: Utility WhatsApp message beyond plan quota, billed at ₹0.115 each

burn_line_items.item: Marketing budget (walk-ins, demo data, ₹500 deposit test refunds)

revenue_targets.notes: 3 solo Jaipur clinics on Starter after walking into ~15 clinics with live phone demo
Mix of Starter and 1-2 Growth upgrades; 2 referrals from pilot clinics
Break-even passed at 3; MRR covers burn 5x, reinvest surplus into WhatsApp message volume

key_assumptions: A solo Jaipur dental clinic pays ₹1,999-3,499/month because one prevented no-show recovers ₹500-2,000 (strategist's slot-loss figure) within the first week.
Delivery cost ₹350/customer = ~150 utility WhatsApp messages at ₹0.115 (₹17) + ~₹333 Razorpay fee on ₹16,500 collected deposits at 2% + GST, assuming 33 deposits of ₹500 per clinic per month.
Blended ₹3,000 avg revenue assumes 70% Starter and 30% Growth mix by Day 90.
Marketing budget ₹5,000/month covers local travel, printed demo sheets and test-deposit refunds; free trials and referral discounts are excluded from revenue.

channels.name: Jaipur clinic walk-ins with live phone demo
channels.tactic: Google Maps list of 100 solo Jaipur dental clinics (Malviya Nagar, Vaishali Nagar, Raja Park, Tonk Road); call 20/day, walk into 5/day with a live WhatsApp reminder + ₹500 Razorpay deposit demo on your phone.

channels.name: WhatsApp DM to dentists from Jaipur dentist groups
channels.tactic: Join 6 Jaipur dentist WhatsApp/Facebook groups (Jaipur Dentists Network, IDA Jaipur chapter); DM 10 dentists/day offering a free 7-day reminder test on their own patient list.

first_10_customers: Day 1-3: Google Maps search 'dental clinic Jaipur', build a sheet of 100 solo clinics with phone numbers, call 20/day to book a 10-minute walk-in demo slot.
Day 4-10: Walk into 5 clinics/day with your phone showing a live WhatsApp reminder + ₹500 Razorpay deposit link firing on a test appointment; ask for a 7-day free pilot on their real patient list.
Day 8-14: Convert 1-2 pilot clinics to paid Starter ₹1,999/month by showing their own no-show count from the pilot week on the dashboard.
Day 10-25: Ask each paying clinic for 2 dentist referrals in their WhatsApp groups; give the referring clinic 1 month free for every referral that pays.
Day 15-30: Post a 30-second screen recording of the reminder→UPI deposit flow in every Jaipur dentist WhatsApp/Facebook group; DM 10 dentists/day from those member lists.
Day 20-30: Close customers 3-10 from walk-ins and group DMs; log every clinic name, date, objection and outcome in a Google Sheet.
growth.cold_message: Namaste doctor, I built a WhatsApp bot that reminds your patients 24h and 2h before their slot and collects a ₹500 UPI deposit in the same chat. I'm giving 3 Jaipur clinics a free 7-day pilot — you only upload your appointment CSV, I handle the rest. Worth a 10-minute demo at your clinic this week?

objections.objection: My receptionist already calls patients, why pay ₹1,999?
objections.response: Your receptionist stops at 8pm and costs ₹8,000-15,000/month in time; the bot runs 24x7 for ₹1,999 — try it free for 7 days on your real list and compare your no-show count.

objections.objection: Patients won't pay a deposit over WhatsApp.
objections.response: Run the free 7-day pilot: if fewer than half your patients confirm or pay the ₹500 UPI link, you pay nothing and I switch it off.

critic.verdict: The plan is technically coherent and fits the bootstrapped constraint well, leveraging low-cost infrastructure to ship a viable MVP. However, the growth strategy relies on a high-friction, high-rejection walk-in sales model that is unrealistic for a solo founder to execute at the proposed volume (5 clinics/day) while building the product. The financial targets are aggressive but plausible if the founder can secure the first 3 pilots, which hinges entirely on overcoming the 'trust barrier' of sending automated messages to patients.
critic.biggest_risk: The founder will fail to secure the first 3 paying customers within 30 days because cold-walking into 5 clinics daily is an inefficient, high-rejection sales channel for a solo founder who is simultaneously building the product; dentists are busy and skeptical of unsolicited tech, leading to a runway burn before revenue starts.
